Aux value.description: Item auxiliary/metadata value. Used to distinguish item variants. Ignored for block items where aux is always 0.

Block Runtime Id.description: Runtime block state ID associated with this item when it represents a block. Used to identify the exact block state placed when the item is used.

Id.description: Send fixed Id of 0 for invalid item

Net Id Variant.description: Optional network ID variant used to track item stack identity across client and server.

Stack size.description: The number of items in the stack. Must be within the item's allowed stack size range.

User Data Buffer.description: The @ItemInstanceUserData.html#ItemInstanceUserData@  binary blob encoded as a String, so it's unsigned varint length prefixed. Get all your nbt+property bytes, calculate the length, write that length, THEN write the data.
